description: This file contains the implementation of the Language class within the OpenCart System Library namespace, responsible for managing language translation strings, loading language files, and caching language data for the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class that manages language strings, loading language files, and caching the language data within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Language object with a language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and its associated directory path to the language loader.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a language string by key, returning the key itself if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a specific key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from a specified file, with support for caching and namespace handling.
